description: This file provides Windows-specific compatibility functions and macros for OpenSSL and Git operations, including path validation, encoding conversions, and platform-specific configurations.

methods.name: mingw_core_config
methods.description: Configures platform-specific settings based on variable and value, using the provided context and callback.

methods.name: int mingw_SSL_set_fd(SSL * ssl,int fd)
methods.description: Sets the file descriptor for the SSL object, converting Windows handle to socket.

methods.name: int mingw_SSL_set_rfd(SSL * ssl,int fd)
methods.description: Sets the read file descriptor for SSL over Windows handle.

methods.name: int mingw_SSL_set_wfd(SSL * ssl,int fd)
methods.description: Sets the write file descriptor for SSL over Windows handle.

methods.name: mingw_query_user_email
methods.description: Retrieves the email of the current user from Git configuration or environment.

methods.name: is_path_owned_by_current_sid
methods.description: Checks if the given path is owned by the current user security identifier.

methods.name: is_valid_win32_path
methods.description: Validates Windows path syntax, disallowing reserved characters and names, considering special cases like NUL.

methods.name: xutftowcsn
methods.description: Converts UTF-8 string to UTF-16LE with length constraints, handling invalid sequences.

methods.name: int xutftowcs(wchar_t * wcs,const char * utf,size_t wcslen)
methods.description: Simplified wrapper for xutftowcsn for null-terminated strings.

methods.name: int xutftowcs_path(wchar_t * wcs,const char * utf)
methods.description: Converts UTF-8 string to UTF-16LE, optimized for file system paths with maximum path length consideration.

methods.name: xwcstoutf
methods.description: Converts UTF-16LE wide string to UTF-8, respecting buffer size constraints.

methods.name: wmain
methods.description: Windows Unicode main entry point that converts arguments from UTF-16 to UTF-8 and delegates to main().

methods.name: open_in_gdb
methods.description: Utility to open debugging session with GDB for the current process.

methods.name: err_win_to_posix
methods.description: Converts Windows error codes to POSIX error codes.

methods.name: have_unix_sockets
methods.description: Checks if Unix domain sockets are supported on the platform.

ctags.name: xutftowcs
ctags.pattern: /^static inline int xutftowcs(wchar_t *wcs, const char *utf, size_t wcslen)$/
